author: Diesing, 1851

note.en: A peanut worm that lives inside holes in rock and coral rubble; a person will not see it without breaking the rock. Recorded in the region from a single museum specimen. Size is a rough figure for the group, not a measured local value.
note.es: Un gusano cacahuate que vive dentro de huecos en roca y escombro de coral; no se ve sin romper la roca. Se registra en la región por un solo espécimen de museo. El tamaño es una cifra aproximada del grupo, no una medida local.

evidence: GBIF: museum specimen record(s) inside the region (MCZ Harvard collections, Cahuita to Manzanillo)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records inside the region box (MCZ specimens)
